explication: Lottery is a Vue-based annual-dinner raffle with an Express data service. The workflow initializes participants and prize configuration, presents them in a 3D name-ball interface, runs draws and supports redraw/reset, then saves and exports results. The graph includes the documented persistence and Excel capabilities. Some API-to-server wiring is not visible in the supplied excerpts, so that relationship is marked unverified.
